{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Artificial intelligence (AI) holds extraordinary potential for both promise and peril.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"AI is helping to cure diseases, predict the weather, and transform education.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"AI is being used to clone voices, commit fraud, institutionalize bias, and undermine democracy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats need to act now and act fast to realize the promise of AI and manage its risks to ensure that AI serves the public interest.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are finding solutions to manage the implications of AI's growing capabilities for Americans' rights, safety and security.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"President Biden issued a landmark Executive Order directing federal agencies to establish new high standards for AI safety and security.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"President Biden issued a landmark Executive Order to protect Americans' privacy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"President Biden issued a landmark Executive Order to advance equity and civil rights.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"President Biden issued a landmark Executive Order to stand up for workers and consumers.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"President Biden issued a landmark Executive Order to promote competitive markets for AI development and use.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to ensuring that workers get a voice in how AI is used in their workplace.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to ensuring that workers share fairly in any economic gains AI produces.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"AI can deepen discrimination, bias, and other abuses in justice, health care, education, and housing.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The Administration has taken action by publishing the Blueprint for an AI Bill of Rights.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The Administration has issued new guidance from federal agencies on combating algorithmic discrimination across the economy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
